title: Redis endpoint is hardcoded, not configured
evidence: MACHINE_PROFILE.json: redis.url_from_env=False; PM_REDIS_URL unset; no PM_* env vars exist at all (only CUDA_PATH). Every component assumes redis://127.0.0.1:6390.
proposed_fix: Single resolver: read PM_REDIS_URL with 127.0.0.1:6390 as documented default; forbid literal '6390' outside that resolver; assert at PREFLIGHT.

title: Redis consumer registrations outlive their processes; nothing reaps them
evidence: 8 ghost consumers across worker-C/D/E/G on pm:jobs:<L> and :cont, idle 18.2-22.4h, pending=0, with ZERO worker processes alive. Removed during RECONCILE. Consumer names (m1-23be3a04 etc.) identify a SESSION, not an experiment attempt, so ownership is unreadable after the fact.
proposed_fix: Name consumers <attempt_id>; teardown must XGROUP DELCONSUMER for its own attempt; VERIFY ABSENCE asserts 0 consumers owned by the attempt.

title: powershell -NoExit wrapper outlives its claude.exe; teardown killed only children
evidence: 38 orphaned launch_lane.ps1 wrappers accumulated (36 from today's teardown + 2 orphaned since 09-16 18:14). A cwd-keyed sweep reported '0 residual' while all 38 were alive, because a wrapper's cwd is C:\Windows\System32, not the worktree.
proposed_fix: Teardown is two-phase (children then wrappers); enumerate wrappers by cmdline, not cwd. Already corrected in practice and recorded in memory.

title: No container runtime on the Windows host; only Docker inside WSL
evidence: podman/docker/nerdctl all absent natively. WSL2 Ubuntu has Docker 29.8.0, sees the GPU (RTX 5060 Ti 15069 MiB), reaches host Redis (PONG), and exposes the repo at /mnt/f.
proposed_fix: Target docker-in-WSL as the container path; treat Podman as UNQUALIFIED here rather than pretending otherwise. GPU-in-container needs separate qualification (nvidia container toolkit).

title: No machine profile / capability declaration existed before this campaign
evidence: Nothing in the repo reported host capabilities; experiments assumed M1's shape. First profile written at campaigns/cw01-2026-09-17/MACHINE_PROFILE.json.
proposed_fix: Experiments declare needs_* capabilities; a profile reports them; the runner matches the two and FAILS CLOSED on a miss (VIII).

title: Experiment state is addressed by hardcoded drive letter and worktree layout
evidence: All paths are F:\Prometheus-worktrees\<seat>-<lane>; 84 worktrees exist (46 nestor). Source, runtime state and durable science share one tree (XI separation violated).
proposed_fix: Resolve roots from one config (repo root, state root, science root); never embed 'F:' in code.

title: GPU-in-container blocked by a single missing package, not by architecture
evidence: docker info runtimes = io.containerd.runc.v2, runc (default runc). No nvidia runtime registered; nvidia-container-runtime / nvidia-container-cli / nvidia-ctk all absent on PATH in WSL. GPU IS visible to WSL itself (nvidia-smi reports RTX 5060 Ti, 15069 MiB).
proposed_fix: Obstacle is ACCIDENTAL, not fundamental: installing nvidia-container-toolkit and registering the runtime would move docker_wsl_gpu from UNQUALIFIED toward testable. Do not install mid-campaign without need; record as the known blocker.

title: A containerized execution path already exists and I nearly built a second one
evidence: 8 prometheus-fossil-* images already present in the WSL docker daemon (octave, i386, simh, legacy, hw, lang, goexplore, c; 533MB-1.37GB), built by the Techne fossil-vault work. Discovered only because I listed images to avoid a pull.
proposed_fix: Before authoring any container story for experiments, inspect how the fossil images are built and invoked; extend that mechanism rather than forking a parallel one (VI).

title: The mechanism under test never fired: re_entries=0 in the treatment arm
evidence: cells_frac bound allowed 0.476 -> one partial claimed ~30 of 64 cells; after 2 writes the region was full, write() returned (0.0, False) permanently, and nothing evicted. 2 keys stored against 1,414 scheduled recurrences, so retention could never be exercised.
proposed_fix: Bound cells_frac to [0.015,0.125]; refresh-in-place; evict via the persist_steps gene.

title: Arms were seeded differently, so the observed treatment advantage was a seed artifact
evidence: Smoke harness seeded each arm mkseed(..., f'smoke|{arm}') -> different item streams. Treatment scored 0.0508 vs control 0.0362 (+40%) WITH ZERO re-entries, so retention contributed nothing to it. An item completes iff demand<=budget, which is arm-independent, so matched arms must give identical info; 583.7 vs 418.9 proved they were unmatched. The pre-registration requires matched worlds and budgets.
proposed_fix: Draw the item stream from a stream_seed INDEPENDENT of the arm; separate policy_seed for organism coin flips. Regression test: with p_reenter=0 the arms must give bit-identical info.

title: persist_steps was a gene under selection that nothing read
evidence: GENE_NAMES included persist_steps and mutation moved it, but run_episode never referenced it. Selection was acting on a gene with no phenotype.
proposed_fix: persist_steps now drives Region.expire(); eviction count is reported.

title: Dead metrics emitted as if measured: A4/Store instantiated but never called
evidence: retrievals_hit / retrievals_miss / held_keys were emitted as permanent zeros. A4 (retrieval-by-content) was constructed each episode and no code path invoked it. Reporting these as data is 'transient runtime facts masquerading as durable science'.
proposed_fix: A4 removed from the minimal form and from the emitted metrics; it re-enters only with I3, which is not in the minimal form. Never emit a field the code cannot move.

title: Smoking the instrument before spending budget caught 5 defects; make it a gate, not a habit
evidence: All of CW01-D009..D012 were found by one INSTANTIATE smoke run costing under a second. Four of them would have produced a publishable-looking but false retention effect.
proposed_fix: Every experiment must pass a mechanism-fires check (the measured mechanism is non-zero) and a matched-arms check (disable the mechanism -> arms identical) before EXECUTE. Push this decision into deterministic machinery rather than leaving it to the agent's judgement (XIV).

title: The I1 sham was not cost-matched, so the dependence test measured a pricing error
evidence: baseline cost 11425 -> I1_sham 15913 (+39%) -> I1_erase 11110 (-3%), a 42-point spread. erase both destroys information AND relieves occupancy; the v2 sham re-charged a WRITE price every step. Erasing the region IMPROVED score (0.04775 vs 0.04702) purely by stopping holding charges -- the intervention was confounded with cost relief.
proposed_fix: sham_release() relieves occupancy identically (hold charge 0) while leaving contents readable, so information survival is the ONLY difference. Q3 is checked on the intervention's own charge (0 vs 0), never on downstream cost, which IS the effect.
_note: fix applied in code; awaiting the verification run before marking FIXED
_verified: sham preserves re_entries 13.50 and info 581.4 identically to baseline while relieving occupancy; erase zeroes both. Intervention charges 0 vs 0.

title: A data-only predicate passed while the world was in fact a free lunch
evidence: Q8's arithmetic form (hold cost >= 10% of recompute at the mean gap) PASSED, yet the empirical sweep showed retention winning at every price from h=0.0 to h=0.40. Reasoning about one partial's economics did not capture whole-episode economics.
proposed_fix: Every experiment needs a REACHABILITY PROBE before EXECUTE: hand-construct a best-case and a worst-case organism and confirm the measured effect can go both ways. Push this into the lifecycle as a deterministic gate (XIV), not agent judgement.

title: The disposition code did not implement the pre-registered COMPLETE rule
evidence: PREREGISTRATION.md: COMPLETE requires an advantage that 'replicates and is intervention-sensitive'. execute_e01.py's disposition logic tested four conditions (beats_control, dependence, mechanism_in_use, backend) and NEVER tested replication, so it returned COMPLETE from one attempt seed. The experiment would have 'succeeded' by redefinition - the exact failure the pre-registration was written to prevent.
proposed_fix: replicate_e01.py runs independent attempt seeds and requires every replicate to beat its control, show dependence, and use the mechanism. Generally: the disposition rule must be EXECUTABLE and derived from the pre-registration, not hand-written per experiment. Candidate for deterministic machinery (XIV).
_verified: replicate_e01.py implements the clause; 5/5 replicates beat control, show dependence and use the mechanism. The disposition rule is now executable.

title: RECONCILE scanned only pm:jobs:* and reported the substrate clean
evidence: VERIFY ABSENCE found 53 ghost consumers across pm:swarm lane groups (lane-A..lane-W), none created by this campaign. RECONCILE had cleaned 8 consumers on pm:jobs:* and declared the listener check complete. Cleaned where it looked, then reported clean everywhere - the same blind spot as the cwd-vs-cmdline process sweep (CW01-D003).
proposed_fix: Residue scans must enumerate ALL streams (scan_iter over pm:* with a type guard), never a hand-listed prefix. Make it one reusable routine used by both RECONCILE and VERIFY ABSENCE so the two cannot disagree.

title: Process residue detection substring-matched Windows system processes and itself
evidence: e02 RECONCILE reported 'stray workers/campaign procs: 8'. Triage: 4x RuntimeBroker.exe, UserOOBEBroker.exe, NVIDIA Overlay.exe, 2x GOG Galaxy QtWebEngineProcess.exe -- 'broker' is a substring of 'RuntimeBroker', 'epoch' appears in browser command lines. 3 of my own bash shells matched ALL FIVE tokens because the Bash tool's command string contains the script. Genuine residue: ZERO.
proposed_fix: residue.process_census(): match only INTERPRETER processes (python/claude/node) on EXACT argv tokens, excluding the ancestor chain AND all descendants of the session root. Never substring-match a joined cmdline; never match generic English words.

title: A capability flag short-circuited an RNG draw, making the random stream arm-dependent
evidence: Q10 smoke: with the mechanism disabled (p_norm=0, p_factor=0) treatment.info = 26.060150179999685 vs control_no_T1.info = 25.524589109989474. Cause: `arms['T1_enabled'] and prng.random() < genome['p_norm']` consumes a draw when the flag is True and skips it when False, so arms walk different random streams. FOUR such sites existed (T1, T2, T3-reduce, T4-bind).
proposed_fix: Draw ALL policy coins unconditionally at the top of each item, then gate on the pre-drawn values. RNG consumption becomes independent of arm AND branch by construction, not by care.
_significance: This is CW01-D010 reproduced in NEW code within an hour of fixing it. The e01 fix treated the symptom (per-arm seeding); the pattern (capability flag short-circuits a draw) survived and recurred. The Q10 STANDING GATE, promoted from that failure, is what caught it -- at INSTANTIATE rather than in a published result. Evidence that promoting a failure to a gate works, and that fixing an instance is not fixing a class.
_status_correction: Logged FIXED in error. The patch script that was supposed to apply the fix died with SyntaxError: unterminated string literal (a substitution string ended in a backslash, which escaped its closing quote), so ZERO patches were applied. The re-verify in the same turn ran against the UNPATCHED file and reported Q10 FAIL with the same numbers as before. Status corrected to OPEN; it flips to FIXED only when a verification run shows bit-identical arms.
_meta_lesson: A ledger that misreports what is repaired is worse than the defect it describes. Never mark FIXED from the act of attempting a fix -- only from a verification that ran after it.
_verified: Q10a: treatment/control_no_T1/control_no_T2 identical on info (27.97750018015499) AND cost (132.95640729764867). Verified by a run AFTER the Edit calls landed, not from the act of patching.

title: Source edits routed through shell heredocs keep getting mangled by escaping
evidence: Third occurrence this session. (1) a backtick in a double-quoted python -c became command substitution and silently DELETED 2 of 12 gate checks while the gate still printed PASS; (2) a quoted heredoc lost a doubled backslash; (3) CW01-D019's patch script died on a substitution string ending in a backslash, applying 0 patches while an adjacent call recorded the defect as FIXED.
proposed_fix: Do not route source edits through a shell. Use the Edit tool directly on the file: no quoting layer, no escaping, and the call fails loudly if the anchor text does not match. Reserve heredocs for running code, never for rewriting it.

title: The recurrence read was gated on the arm flag only, with no gene controlling it
evidence: Q10b: with p_bind=0, treatment and control_no_T4 produced IDENTICAL info (36.28852638596173) but costs differing by exactly 14.0 = 28 reads x 0.5. The read fired on every recurrence whenever T4_enabled, regardless of genome, so an organism paid to look even when nothing had ever been stored. A forced cost with no genetic control is not something evolution can optimise away.
proposed_fix: Gate the read on r_bind < p_bind, so p_bind=0 genuinely disables the whole T4 mechanism and Q10b becomes a meaningful matched-arms test.
_note: fix applied via Edit; flips to FIXED only after a verification run
_verified: Q10b: with p_bind=0, treatment and control_no_T4 now agree exactly -- cost delta 0.0 (was 14.0), reads=0 in both. Q9 still fires (ordered=10), so the fix did not silence the mechanism.

title: The gain detector fired on pure noise; a percent-lift criterion cannot work here
evidence: Two-sided calibration: 0% synthetic noise -> 1 gain; 1% sub-threshold -> 3 gains; even a 15% planted step yielded 4 gains at [5,13,26,40], three of them BEFORE the step existed. The no-selection null gave 3 spurious gains with lifts 5.12%, 10.12%, 11.54%. Cause: the null lineage mean has sd 0.00965 on ~0.13 = 7.4% relative, so the 2% effect-size threshold sat far below the noise floor.
proposed_fix: Add a noise-RELATIVE criterion (>= min_sd_separation pooled standard deviations) alongside percent lift, then CALIBRATE the threshold from the measured null distribution rather than hand-tuning until the null goes quiet. Re-verify both directions: null -> 0 gains AND a realistic planted step still found.
_significance: Q11 was written as a standing gate precisely because a detector that finds gains in noise manufactures ratchets. A null-ONLY test would have looked merely noisy; the positive controls are what revealed the detector was firing on nothing at all.
_verified: sd-separation criterion added and thresholds CALIBRATED from 3 independent nulls (210 pooled windows, 6.6-7.5% relative sd). Null lift p99=12.28, sd-sep p99=1.29 -> operating point ES>=12.3%, sd_sep>=1.3. At that point: 0/1/5% planted -> 0 gains; 20% -> found at gen 40; 40% -> found at gen 39; two held-out nulls -> 0 gains.
_residual_limitation: RESOLUTION LIMIT, recorded not tuned away: a 10% planted step produced one gain at gen 65 while the true step was at gen 40. Near the floor, noise on a sub-threshold elevation can trip a window in the WRONG PLACE. Consequence for e02 specifically: condition 1 of the ratchet definition is TEMPORAL ORDERING, so ordering claims must not rest on near-floor gains. Detection bar 12.3%; ORDERING bar raised to 20%, where localization was verified exact (gen 40 and 39).

title: Two reachability-probe genomes were identical, producing a spurious Q8 FAIL
evidence: NOFAC = dict(ORD, p_factor=0.0) and NORM_ONLY = dict(ORD, p_factor=0.0, p_norm=0.95) are the SAME genome, because ORD already carried p_norm=0.95. Both rows were identical on every column (score 0.16774, info 238.5, cost 1427.4, t1 144.6). The 'baseline' therefore already normalised, so the test `normalise-only < baseline` compared a genome with itself, returned equal, and tripped Q8 FAIL. No true zero-transformation baseline existed in the comparison at all.
proposed_fix: Build probe genomes from a COMMON base with every differing gene set explicitly, and assert pairwise distinctness before running. A probe suite that silently contains duplicates cannot test what it claims to test.
_significance: The valid parts of that run were in the predicted direction (ordered vs unordered +22.66%, with more info AND lower cost), so the FAIL verdict was an artifact of my own probe construction rather than a property of the world. A gate that fails for the wrong reason is as dangerous as one that passes for the wrong reason -- it would have sent e02 into a redesign it did not need.

title: The driver reported a conclusion about a test that never ran
evidence: Disposition reason read 'gains occur but are ADDITIVE: reverting the earlier gain costs no more than that gain was worth'. K1 was never executed in any of 4 replicates (0,0,0,1 gains above the ordering bar; all four `why` fields say condition 1 not met). The branch `n_ratchet == 0` conflates 'knockout showed additivity' with 'ordering never established'.
proposed_fix: Every disposition branch must name the test that produced it, and a branch may only be reached if that test actually ran. Assert `K1 executed` before emitting any statement about knockout results.

title: The gain detector is blind to the generations where all the action is
evidence: All improvement occurs in generations 0-9, but detect_gains cannot evaluate g < baseline_window (=5) at all, and its gen-5 baseline is drawn from the rise itself. Raw step analysis of the same run finds 2 windows >= the 20% ordering bar (max 44.20%); the detector reported 1. Q11 calibrated it against a NULL and against PLANTED MID-SERIES steps -- neither exercised a step at the START of the run.
proposed_fix: Seed the baseline from the ANCESTOR population rather than from generation 0-4 of the run, so early steps are evaluable; and calibrate against planted steps at the beginning, not only the middle, of a series.

title: Per-generation lineage trajectories were never emitted as durable rows
evidence: rows_written = 6 (4 replicate summaries + backend + disposition). e01 emitted 128. The 4 x 80 = 320 per-generation records -- which ARE the interesting evidence here, and which the trajectory diagnosis had to RE-RUN evolution to recover -- exist only inside RESULT.json summaries.
proposed_fix: Emit one row per generation per replicate, as e01 did. Durable evidence must not require re-running the experiment to inspect.

title: Neutral control genes hitchhike, bounding the resolution of gene-ordering measurements
evidence: neutral_a travelled +0.130/+0.189/+0.104/+0.022 (mean +0.111) and neutral_b +0.048/-0.202/-0.072/-0.102 across replicates, despite Q6 verifying they have NO phenotype. Cause: elite selection copies genomes wholesale, carrying neutral genes along. Selected genes travel ~+0.45-0.54, so the signal/drift ratio is ~4x, not infinite.
proposed_fix: Report neutral-gene travel alongside any gene-ordering claim as the drift floor; treat ordering differences smaller than the neutral travel timescale as unresolved.

title: The population converges before sequential discovery is possible
evidence: +203.2% within generations 0-9, then -1.6% to +3.0% across the remaining 70 generations. All selected genes fix by generation 2-5. A ratchet requires gain A to fix BEFORE gain B appears; there is no room for that here.
proposed_fix: Weaken population dynamics (larger elite_fraction, smaller mutation_sigma) so discovery spreads across generations. This changes OBSERVABILITY, not the economics -- prices, affordances and gates stay exactly as pre-registered.
_verified: Confirmed real AND confirmed not to change the verdict. Weakening selection (elite .25->.75, sigma .12->.02) spread p_norm crossing from gen 6 to gen 31 and p_factor from 4 to 18, but p_factor stayed FIRST in 6/6 runs. Convergence speed was a genuine observability limit; it was not the cause of the NULL.

title: The world's latent facts were redrawn every episode, making the phenomenon unlearnable
evidence: run_episode drew the hidden structure from the stream seed when none was passed, and evolve passed None. Since the stream seed varies per organism AND per generation, four stream seeds produced four different structures: [[4,13,15],[5,10,15],[2,13,14],[1,3,11]] then [[2,4,11],[0,13,14],[0,6,13],[5,11,14]] and so on. Organisms in the same generation were not even compared on the same world. SECOND HALF: make_items draws the class feature centres from the episode rng too, so the observable signature also means something different every episode.
proposed_fix: attempt_structure() draws ONE structure per attempt from the attempt seed, and evolve seeds it when none is given. The class centres need the same treatment: a latent fact about the world must outlive the episode and be shared across organisms, or conditional routing is unlearnable IN PRINCIPLE.
_significance: Had EXECUTE run, e03 would have returned a confident NULL for a purely artefactual reason - the same shape as e02's CW01-D009 (the mechanism never fired) and e01's CW01-D010 (arms never matched). Three experiments, three variants of 'the instrument could not have shown the effect even if it existed'. That is now the single most common failure mode in this campaign and argues for a standing gate: before EXECUTE, prove the phenomenon is LEARNABLE, not merely that the mechanism can fire.
_verified: attempt_structure and attempt_centres draw once per attempt; evolve seeds both and passes them to every episode. Class-0 centroid spread across episodes fell from 1.955 to 0.241, and structure is identical across calls. Verified by a run AFTER the edits, not from making them.

title: Promoted the campaign's dominant failure mode into an executable gate
evidence: Five defects across three experiments share one shape - the instrument could not have shown the effect even if it existed: D009 (mechanism never fired), D010 (arms never matched), D019 (arms desynchronised), D025 (detector blind where the signal was), D029 (latent facts redrawn every episode). Each was caught only because I happened to look.
proposed_fix: lib/learnability.py: before EXECUTE, hand-build a competent and an incompetent organism and prove (a) they differ (assert_distinct, from D023), (b) the competent one wins by a real margin, (c) the mechanism actually fires. require() raises rather than warns. Verified: a 100 percent advantage with a dead mechanism still FAILS the gate, which is exactly the D009 shape.
_significance: Q10 was promoted from D010 into a gate and then caught D019 in new code within the hour. That is the campaign's clearest evidence that gates transfer and memos do not. e03 is the first experiment to pass a learnability gate before spending any budget.

title: The backend counterfactual was passed by assertion rather than by running it
evidence: WORLD.json specifies a secondary backend (redis-backed activation ledger, namespace pm:cw01:e03:) and a cap_rule capping the disposition at INCONCLUSIVE if it is not exercised. execute_e03.py instead pinged redis and recorded backend={equivalent: True, detail: 'e03 is pure in-process arrays; no substrate-backed state to diverge'}. The TestLog then carried ran=True, passed=True for a test whose entire content was an assertion, and the COMPLETE disposition cited it.
proposed_fix: Discharge IX by MEASUREMENT: reimplement the episode physics independently (python sets and explicit loops instead of vectorised boolean arrays) and require identical metrics. That tests IX's intent - physics must not depend on one implementation - rather than redefining the gate to something already true.
_significance: This is CW01-D024 one level up. lineage.decide correctly refuses to reach a branch whose tests did not run - but it trusts the TestLog, and I populated the log with an assertion dressed as a result. A gate is only as honest as what is recorded against it. The machinery cannot detect a caller who lies to it, so the rule must be: never record ran=True for a check that performed no comparison.
_verified: IX discharged by MEASUREMENT: an independent reimplementation of the episode physics (python sets and explicit loops instead of vectorised boolean arrays) agrees EXACTLY with the primary implementation. 288 comparisons across 3 genomes x 3 arms x 4 seeds x 8 metrics; worst absolute divergence 0.000e+00.

title: The scarce resource was specified without checking that it is actually scarce
evidence: WORLD.json set channel capacity 12. Measured occupancy under an ALWAYS-PLACE genome is 6.28 unconstrained, so capacity NEVER bound: 0 placement failures even when everything was placed. With carrying effectively free, control_no_triage (2.45680) BEAT treatment (1.98291) - blind placement is optimal and any selectivity is pure loss. e04 would have returned a NULL entirely about my pricing.
proposed_fix: Derive the capacity from measured demand, by a contention rule stated BEFORE seeing the triage outcome: unconstrained occupancy 6.28 -> capacity 4 (ratio ~1.6, 55.4 full-failures under always-place). Same class as e01's Q7, where a declared 0.40 contradicted an implied 0.346: a spec parameter nobody checked against the distribution it governs.

title: The learnability comparison conflated selectivity with worth-alignment
evidence: The first e04 probe used worst=BLIND_PLACE_ALL, which differs from the triager in BOTH how much it places (selectivity 1.000 vs 0.452) AND which items (aligned vs none). The verdict then swung with capacity - triage +9.30% at cap 3, +3.42% at 4, -14.43% at 6 - because blind placement wins on raw hits, not on targeting. Against BAD_TRIAGER, which holds selectivity roughly fixed (0.548) and inverts alignment, triage wins at EVERY capacity and MORE as capacity grows (+20.5%, +34.7%, +51.2%).
proposed_fix: The learnability gate must compare the BEST conditional policy against the BEST policy the non-conditional ARM could evolve into - not one arbitrary blind genome. Sweep the non-conditional biases to find its optimum, then compare. Also report an anti-aligned control at matched selectivity, which isolates alignment from volume.
_significance: Choosing capacity 3 because that is where triage wins would have been fitting the world to the hypothesis. The capacity is now fixed by a contention rule declared before the outcome was known, and the comparison is best-vs-best.

title: A gate passed because nothing happened (vacuous pass), for the third time in four experiments
evidence: Q10 (matched arms) passed with info=0.0 on BOTH arms: with weights zeroed, b_place=0.0 sat exactly on the placement threshold and b_rec=-9.0 disabled recompute, so the organism placed nothing, retrieved nothing and earned nothing while paying 33.6 in retrieval attempts. Two arms agreeing the world is empty is not evidence they are matched. Re-run on live genomes: b_place=1.0/b_rec=-9.0 gives info 135.2457, 120 placements, 50 hits, bit-identical across arms - the earned verdict.
proposed_fix: learnability.assert_live / require_live: an identity or equality comparison is REFUSED unless the named liveness metrics are non-zero. Every matched-arms check must declare what must be alive for it to mean anything.
_family: e01 close_sweep recorded {checks_run: 0, ok: true}; e01 Q4 'passed' comparing three EMPTY strings from crashed subprocesses; e04 Q10 passed on info=0.0. Three instances across four experiments. The common shape is a check whose success condition is satisfied by the ABSENCE of the thing being checked.

title: The decisive intervention was tested by sign alone, with no magnitude floor
evidence: execute_e04.py recorded J1_collapses = (scr < sham) -- a bare sign test. Across replicates the effect was -8.8%, -2.8%, -13.0%, -10.7%, and the 4/4 claim rested on r02's -2.8% being in the right DIRECTION. No noise floor had been measured, so a difference of that size could be run-to-run variation in the score estimate. e03's equivalent effect was -37.6% to -61.0%, where the sign test was harmless because the margin was enormous; here it is not.
proposed_fix: Every intervention verdict must clear an EMPIRICAL noise floor, measured by running the cost-matched sham against ITSELF across independent seed blocks. The sham-vs-sham distribution is the null for 'an intervention that does nothing'; an effect inside that band is not evidence. Same family as CW01-D022 (a gain detector with no noise floor fired on pure noise) and CW01-D034 (a check satisfiable without the effect).
_pattern: Three variants now: a detector with no noise floor (D022), a check that passes when nothing happened (D034), and a verdict that tests direction but not size (D035). All are conditions satisfiable in the absence of the phenomenon.
_verified: infometrics.sham_null and effect_clears_null landed and verified: reproduces the 3/4 verdict on nulls matched to measured bands, refuses fewer than 3 sham estimates, passes a -50 pct effect, rejects -0.2 pct in a noisy null.

title: Fifth shell-escaping failure: prose routed through a heredoc again
evidence: A combined close-and-commit call died at PARSE time with unexpected EOF looking for a matching quote, so none of it ran: no verify-absence, no ledger flip, no state update, no commit. Cause: a multi-paragraph commit message containing apostrophes was embedded in a Python heredoc inside bash. Prior occurrences: a backtick silently deleted 2 of 12 gate checks while the gate still printed PASS; a quoted heredoc lost a doubled backslash; a patch script applied 0 of 5 edits while an adjacent call marked the defect FIXED; an e03 commit died the same way.
proposed_fix: Absolute rule, no exceptions: commit messages and any multi-line prose are written with the Write tool to a file, then referenced by path. Bash calls carry mechanical steps only, with short strings and no apostrophes. Source edits use the Edit tool. Heredocs are for running code, never for authoring text.
_note: D020 recorded this rule after the third occurrence. I violated it twice more. The rule was correct; the failure was not following it.

title: A zero-variance world silently disabled the noise-floor gate built one experiment earlier
evidence: The first world_e05 drew items ONCE per attempt and the organism is deterministic, so every score was a single exact number with zero variance. Two consequences. First, infometrics.effect_clears_null needs independent sham estimates across seed blocks; repeated evaluation returns identical values, so no floor could be built and Q11 was unsatisfiable as written. Second, evolution optimised against one frozen 120-item list, and with K=8 the entire strategy space is 256 carried sets against a static target.
proposed_fix: Keep the demand STRUCTURE attempt-stable (capability assignment plus a pool of demand templates, preserving D029 learnability) but draw the ITEMS per episode from that pool. Variation returns, the noise floor becomes measurable, and the search is no longer against a frozen list.
_significance: A gate that CANNOT FIRE reads exactly like a gate that passed. D035 was landed one experiment ago precisely so intervention verdicts could not rest on sign alone; a zero-variance world would have neutralised it without any error message. Caught by reading the world before running it, not by the gate itself.
fix_evidence: world_e05.make_items draws items PER EPISODE from the attempt-stable pool; variance restored and measurable - fixtures F2/F6 build a non-degenerate null band [-6.64, +7.11] on BEST, which was impossible under the zero-variance world.

title: An intervention was applied to the mixture but not to its own baseline
evidence: superadditivity() forwarded **kw (carrying force_disjunctive=True) to the MIXTURE measurement but not to solo_values(). The mixture was therefore measured under disjunction while its solo baselines were measured under conjunction. The resulting M3 reading (superadditivity +1.8330 with the law OFF versus -0.2184 with it ON) compared two different worlds and is void.
proposed_fix: **kw must reach every baseline. An intervention that does not apply to the control is not a controlled comparison.
_note: I initially diagnosed the inversion as a ratio/fixed-cost problem alone and said so with more confidence than the evidence supported. That was part of it, but this is the larger cause, and it was visible in the code rather than in the numbers.
fix_evidence: world_e05.solo_values accepts and applies **kw, so an intervention reaches every baseline; lib/learnability.require_controlled added as a standing guard. Fixture F4 MEASURES propagation (solo baselines move between composition laws) rather than trusting the guard, which is tautological at the nsa call site.

title: Superadditivity was defined on a ratio whose denominator every organism shares
evidence: score = info/cost, and cost includes an item-attempt floor of 0.5 x 120 = 60.0 paid by every organism regardless of what it carries; the maximum carry cost is 24.0. Summing solo SURPLUSES of that ratio double-counts the floor's dilution, inflating the additive prediction. Measured: complementary -0.2184, arbitrary -0.5231, carry-all -0.9712 -- all negative, which is an artefact of the denominator, not a finding about composition.
proposed_fix: Define superadditivity on INFORMATION, which composes linearly, and report cost separately so the trade stays visible without contaminating the arithmetic.
fix_evidence: superadditivity and ablation defined on INFORMATION (world_e05.mean_info), carry cost reported separately. Consistency gate A8 now checks the basis across VERDICT_CONTRACT, QUALIFY and all five WORLD.measurements keys: PASS.

title: Carrying could never be contested: conjunctive demand makes marginal value INCREASING
evidence: Score is monotone in components carried at EVERY swept carry price (3.0, 6.0, 10.0, 15.0, 22.0, 30.0). Carry-all always wins. At carry=30.0 the eight components cost 240 against a 60 item floor and carry-all still scores 1.0474 vs singleton 0.5308, because info grows about 13x from singleton to carry-all while cost grows about 5x. Each added component unlocks new COMBINATIONS, so marginal value rises rather than diminishes and a linear carry price cannot outrun it.
proposed_fix: A capacity constraint rather than a price: give the organism a carry BUDGET B and ask whether, within it, evolution finds a set worth more than its members alone. That preserves the pre-registered question (superadditivity within a budget) instead of tuning a price that provably cannot bind. Same shape as e04's capacity that never bound (CW01-D032), but here no price value fixes it.
fix_evidence: carry BUDGET B=3 replaces the unbindable carry price, present in WORLD arms, QUALIFY and the frozen contract (gate A4), derived by one canonical rule across all three artifacts (gate A7), and enforced at load time (gate A13: load_cfg refuses a WORLD whose max_components disagrees with budget_B).

title: The M3 pass criterion compared superadditivity ACROSS composition laws, which is invalid
evidence: I required superadditivity to collapse toward zero with the composition law off. It went to -79.54 (disjunctive) against -5.56 (conjunctive), and I read that as the measure still being wrong. But raw superadditivity is not comparable across laws: under disjunction the additive prediction is inflated by coverage OVERLAP, since the sum of solo information greatly exceeds the union. That is arithmetic, not composition. The valid contrast is WITHIN law: complementary -5.56 vs arbitrary -23.82, i.e. complementary is +18.26 better, which is the predicted direction and was hidden by the criterion.
proposed_fix: Compare complementary against arbitrary sets of MATCHED SIZE under the SAME law, and report the law-off case as its own within-law contrast rather than as a cross-law difference.
_note: Second time in e05 that I declared the measure broken when the CRITERION was broken. Both times the numbers were informative and my test of them was not.
fix_evidence: raw cross-law superadditivity is no longer a verdict quantity; the statistic is a difference-in-differences on NORMALISED superadditivity (gate A9, all four artifacts agree). Fixture F3 exhibits the trap directly: BEST under disjunction reads -22.63% from coverage overlap, and is never read as a verdict.

title: Pass criteria invented with arbitrary magnitude thresholds, three times in one experiment
evidence: e05 declared the superadditivity measure broken three times when the CRITERION was broken. (1) M3 required superadditivity to collapse toward zero with the law off, but raw superadditivity is not comparable across laws because disjunctive overlap inflates the additive prediction. (2) The replacement required gap_conj > abs(gap_disj), a magnitude comparison with no basis in the hypothesis; it reported FAIL on +18.25 vs -23.55, which is in fact the predicted dissociation. (3) The printed conclusion said 'alignment pays equally without conjunctions' when the measured effect was negative without them.
proposed_fix: A pass criterion must be derived from the hypothesis, not chosen to look strict. For an interaction claim the statistic is a difference-in-differences on a NORMALISED quantity, which is immune to the scale differences that broke the first two.
_pattern: Campaign-wide, my criteria now fail more often than my worlds. e04 had a sign test with no magnitude floor (D035); e05 has three criteria with magnitudes that do not follow from the hypothesis. The worlds are getting reliable; the judgements about them are the weak link.
fix_evidence: the invented gap_conj > abs(gap_disj) magnitude threshold is gone; eligibility is infometrics.effect_clears_null against a measured null of >=8 blocks (gate A10). Fixture F6 shows an effect inside its own band refused and one outside admitted.

title: e06 world was a fixation lottery: no coexistence reachable, control A fixed 6/6
evidence: Q16 reachability probe at realistic scale (96 organisms, 80 generations, 3 seeds x 2 seeded frequencies): 18/18 runs reached fixation, 0/18 coexistence. CONTROL A - two labels on ONE substrate, no representational difference whatsoever - fixed 6/6 (L0 3, L1 3), so fixation carried no information about representation. mixed_assortative fixed on TREE 6/6, a structurally destined winner. Design requirement 4 (TREE fixes, TAPE fixes, coexistence, contingent dominance and no-difference must EACH be attainable) was therefore violated before any budget was spent.
proposed_fix: ANALYTIC CAUSE: assortative recombination is a POSITIVE frequency-dependence mechanism - rare means fewer compatible partners means worse means rarer. On its own it can only accelerate fixation and can NEVER produce coexistence. WORLD.json declared a competing negative-FD mechanism (cost of intermediate structure varying with composition) which was never implemented. FIXED by adding a representation-blind negative-FD channel: each item is a RESOURCE and organisms that solve it SPLIT its value, so a common strategy dilutes its own reward. Sharing keys on WHICH ITEMS ARE SOLVED, never on the substrate label, so the task stays blind. Selection changed from deterministic truncation over 24 elites to tournament, because that truncation let drift dominate and is why control A fixed every run. Amendment is PRE-DATA: no contract is hashed and no organism has been evaluated under a frozen criterion.
found_by: Q16 reachability probe run BEFORE freezing the contract

title: e06 single-niche hypothesis TESTED AND REFUTED; niche structure and sharing both work
evidence: After CW01-D052's resource-sharing fix failed to change anything (control A still fixed 6/6, coexistence still 0/18), I hypothesised the cause was a SINGLE-NICHE world in which sharing is a monotonic rescaling. I measured it before filing or acting: Jaccard overlap between the item sets TREE and TAPE solve is 0.531 (not near-total); 23 items are solved ONLY by TREE and 15 ONLY by TAPE; 26 items are TREE-dominated and 17 TAPE-dominated. Sharing ON vs OFF gives a fitness rank correlation of +0.629 with only 12/24 top-quartile overlap, so it substantially REORDERS fitness. Both halves of the hypothesis are false: niche structure EXISTS and sharing IS active.
proposed_fix: No world change follows from this entry - it is recorded so a later session does not re-test a refuted hypothesis. It also documents that the intrinsic gap is large (solo task score TREE 0.486 vs TAPE 0.250, gap +0.2365), which is the next candidate explanation: a rare-type advantage confined to ~15 exclusive items may be too weak to offset a ~2x intrinsic advantage. PROCESS NOTE: this is the second time in e06 that reasoning ran ahead of measurement. The cheap generation-zero probe should have preceded both the sharing fix and this hypothesis.
found_by: diagnostic probe run before filing the defect it was meant to support

title: e06 target was generated in TREE's native form: no mutual invasibility, coexistence impossible
evidence: Generation-zero probe across seeded frequencies {0.10,0.25,0.50,0.75,0.90} (no evolutionary confound, 6 replicates per point): TREE per-capita fitness 0.507 (rare) to 0.345 (common); TAPE 0.289 (rare) to 0.128 (common). Both slopes NEGATIVE, so resource sharing does create rare-advantage - but across the TESTED range TREE's measured LOWER envelope (0.345) exceeds TAPE's measured UPPER envelope (0.289), so there is NO OBSERVED CROSSING and no mutual invasibility IN THE EXERCISED DOMAIN. CORRECTION (operator, and the overclaim was mine): an earlier version of this entry said coexistence was 'impossible'. That is stronger than what was measured. The curves were never analytically bounded over the full frequency interval; upgrading this to a proof requires deriving monotonic bounds from the generation-zero fitness function. Separately, control A fixes at generation 26 against a neutral-drift expectation of ~N=96, so its noise floor is LINEAGE HITCHHIKING, not drift - deferred as a separable defect.
proposed_fix: ROOT CAUSE, and it is mine: attempt_target generated the hidden function as a depth-3 EXPRESSION TREE - one substrate's native form. Scoring was representation-blind, but the WORLD was not. A tree target is trivially expressible by TREE and awkward for TAPE, which manufactured the +0.2365 intrinsic gap (solo task score 0.486 vs 0.250). This satisfies design requirement 1 literally while violating its spirit through the target GENERATOR rather than the reward function. FIXED by generating targets as straight-line DAGs with a controlled REUSE rate: low reuse is a tree (TREE compact), high reuse references intermediates repeatedly (TAPE holds them in registers, TREE must duplicate). Neither substrate is native to the family. Selection strength is deliberately NOT changed in the same step - one variable at a time. PROMOTED TO A GATE: mutual invasibility at generation zero is the precondition for coexistence and is now a Q16 sub-predicate, measured cheaply before any evolution runs.
closure_evidence: Q16 gate executed on the redesigned operation-graph generator: Delta(r) = F_TREE - F_TAPE measured per reuse band is -0.0130, +0.0573, +0.0656, -0.0099 - it CHANGES SIGN across bands of one substrate-neutral generator, which is the two-sided comparative advantage the tree-native target generator could never produce (legacy fixture: single band, delta +0.0036, no sign change). The substrate leak is removed. The world is still REFUSED for other reasons, logged separately; this entry closes only the leak it names.

title: e06 TREE has no static compactness advantage; gen-0 invasibility gate was mis-aimed
evidence: The D054 DAG/reuse redesign failed on every count. (a) DEGENERACY: the reuse=0.50 target is CONSTANT - 1 distinct output over 400 draws - and reuse=0.00 yields only 7; the op set {add,sub,mul,min,max,gate} over input domain [0,3] collapses outputs, and reuse amplifies it. (b) ADVANTAGE FLIPPED rather than becoming two-sided: TAPE outsolves TREE at ALL four reuse levels (-0.060, -0.068, -0.153, -0.027), sign never changes. (c) Mutual invasibility still FAILS: TREE invades when rare, TAPE does not. Third consecutive world iteration to fail.
proposed_fix: TWO DEEPER FINDINGS, both of which invalidate earlier premises. FIRST: under this price list TAPE is UNIVERSALLY AT LEAST AS COMPACT as TREE - TAPE expresses any tree with n internal nodes in n instructions, while TREE pays ~2n+1 nodes counting leaves. TREE therefore has NO static compactness advantage; I assumed one in WORLD.json ('TREE compact, cheap') and never measured it. No reuse-spectrum tuning can fix a price list that dominates in one direction. SECOND: TREE's only plausible advantage is DYNAMIC - subtree crossover transplants an intact functional unit where one-point tape crossover disrupts register plumbing - and a dynamic advantage CANNOT appear in a random population. The mutual_invasibility gate promoted in D054 measures standing fitness at GENERATION ZERO and is therefore mis-aimed: it would report 'not invasible' even in a world where coexistence genuinely emerges through evolution. Gate replaced with proper invasion analysis - evolve each substrate alone to equilibrium, introduce the other RARE, measure its growth rate, both directions. World redesign deliberately DEFERRED until the gate measures the right thing; designing a fourth world against a mis-aimed gate is how the previous three failed.
found_by: post-redesign probe measuring target diversity and per-class comparative advantage

title: e06 reuse axis is not realised: requested bands 0/0.25/0.5/0.75 measure 0.12/0.12/0.25/0.12
evidence: First execution of the redesigned generator. Q16 gate REFUSED the world on P1 and P3. P1: band 0.75 is degenerate (4 distinct outputs against a threshold of 8) even after rejection sampling. P3: TAPE invades TREE (0.104 -> 0.312) but TREE cannot invade TAPE (0.104 -> 0.000). DIAGNOSTIC TYING BOTH TO ONE CAUSE: measured fan-out reuse is 0.12/0.12/0.25/0.12 against requested bands 0.00/0.25/0.50/0.75 - the environmental axis is FLAT and is not being realised. tree_cost runs 11/9/7/5 as the band rises, which is BACKWARDS: genuine shared structure should make TREE more expensive to realise, not less. _make_graph concentrates picks onto already-used nodes, producing narrow shallow graphs with dead sub-structure, which is also why band 0.75 goes degenerate. Consequence: Delta(r)'s sign change (P2 PASS) is real but not yet demonstrably REUSE-DRIVEN; it may be graph-to-graph variation.
proposed_fix: ONE causal feature, per the operator decision budget: how reuse is realised in graph construction. Reuse must raise the fan-out of nodes that are REACHABLE FROM THE OUTPUT, so higher reuse means genuine sharing (raising tree_cost relative to tape_cost) rather than dead narrow graphs. Nothing else changes - not sharing, selection, population, mutation or the measurement stack. Qualification is then re-run once. If it still refuses, e06 closes as INCONCLUSIVE / DESIGN UNREACHABLE and the campaign proceeds to e07.
found_by: first execution of the unexercised world rewrite, Q16 hard gate
closure_evidence: Correction applied (reuse draws from PRODUCED nodes only; unconsumed produced nodes folded into a single output). Re-run of the Q16 gate: P1 now PASSES - distinct outputs 15/10/8/17 across bands, band 0.75 recovered from 4 to 17. tree_cost 25/39/33/39 against tape_cost 12/14/12/14, no longer FALLING as reuse rises, so dead sub-structure is gone. RESIDUAL, recorded in DISPOSITION.json rather than pursued under the one-correction budget: measured fan-out is still only 0.00/0.07/0.17/0.07 against requested bands 0.00/0.25/0.50/0.75, so Delta(r)'s sign change is real but not demonstrably reuse-driven.

title: writerlock precondition did not run and the commit proceeded unguarded
evidence: Closing e06 I stated I would verify no live RowWriter held the worktree before the git write, using lib/writerlock. The check was written as an inline `python -c` containing a Windows path .replace('/', backslash) whose escaping collapsed through bash quoting into an unterminated string literal; it exited 1 without performing any check. The shell chain used ';' rather than '&&', so `git add` and `git commit` ran regardless and commit 0d5d5f2de was made with NO liveness check at all. Retroactive verification (heredoc, no inline escaping) returned writerlock PASS with zero markers in <git-dir>/pm-rowwriters, so the commit WAS in fact safe - but 'it turned out fine' is not 'I checked', and the guard I had just built was absent at the one moment it existed for.
proposed_fix: NO REMEDIATION BUILT, deliberately. Both root causes are already covered by standing rules: anything containing backslashes goes through a quoted heredoc rather than an inline python -c, and a guard must gate the action it protects via '&&' or an explicit exit-code check, never ';'. lib/writerlock already exists and is proven by observed refusal; maximum recursive validation depth is ONE, so no checker-for-the-checker is warranted. Logged and continuing, per the Class C rule. The campaign may close with this OPEN.
found_by: self-audit of the e06 closing commit, after noticing WRITERLOCK_RC=1 in the transcript

title: e07 evolution never reaches state-dependent computation; state deletion is inert on evolved organisms
evidence: Pilot (4 x 40-gen STATIC lineages, top 16 each): intact score 0.28-0.46 vs the hand-built accumulator's 0.74; useful computation above each organism's own stateless twin ~0.05 (probe B). At the REAL budget (probe C, 120 gens) top-8 intact 0.35, state dependence 0.06-0.11, AURC at k=3 0.92-1.03. Consequence: P4 conditional variance ratio 0.66 (need 3), and P3 vacuously passes because nothing is lost. Probe F: diagonal recurrence (per-cell leaky integrators) changes nothing (dep ~0.005 at 40 gens, ~0.06 at 120). Probe G, single search-regime features at 40 gens: mut_sigma 0.05->0.20 collapses the population (I 0.15-0.17, below the zero-output floor); init_sigma 0.1->0.5 collapses it (I 0.09-0.12); lifetimes_per_eval 2->8 raises state dependence 0.03->0.09 and intact 0.33->0.41, damage still inert (AURC >= 0.987 at k=3). CORRECTION of my own reading: the fitness trajectory's swings (mean 0.31->0.08->0.35) are theta-draw noise, because the zero-output floor is 0 whenever |theta|>1; they are not mutational meltdown. The search is simply too slow to climb from a 0.1-scale random genome to the accumulator ridge, which needs coordinated moves of the recurrent gain up and the input gain down.
proposed_fix: The ONE permitted correction: lifetimes_per_eval 2->8 (Amendment 2), the only feature that moved state use in the right direction. A future attempt needs a different organism or search: e.g. persistence expressed as a bounded per-cell gene in [0,1] with the input gain tied to (1-a) so the accumulator ridge is a one-gene move, or a search budget an order of magnitude larger, verified by the same cheap pilot before any preregistration is frozen.
found_by: first gate run (P4), probes B, C, F, G

title: e08 Q6-2 'reduced participation' fixture did not reduce participation
evidence: The fixture organism was built with every codebook row set to action 7 (the costliest) but its tensor-train forward still chose the abstain row often enough to survive all 32 ticks on all 64 held seeds (live ticks 2048/2048, held64 91). A constant-action probe showed action 7 alone dies at ~tick 25 (25.6 live ticks, final charge 0), so early death IS reachable in w13; the fixture had simply not forced it. QUALIFY run 1 reported the fixture WRONG for that reason.
proposed_fix: Fixture rebuilt so the forward CANNOT abstain: all cores masked (the contraction becomes a fixed vector v) and the readout set so index 1 always wins for that v; verified always_acts_7 on 64 random observations. No predicate, threshold or accounting rule changed. Record preserved as QUALIFY_run1.json.

title: e08 Q6-2 comparator measured static burden against the wrong organism
evidence: QUALIFY run 2: the repaired fixture died early as intended (1638/2048 live ticks, held64 0.0) but the checker compared its static burden with fixture 1's abstainer, a different genome with a different read mask, and reported WRONG. The accounting was correct; the comparator's reference was not the fixture's own abstaining twin.
proposed_fix: Comparator now builds the SAME genome with the codebook zeroed and requires equal static burden against it, plus lower live ticks and non-competence. QUALIFY run 3: CHARGED_LOWER_WORK_VISIBLE; all seven predicates pass. Record preserved as QUALIFY_run2.json.

title: e08 Q3 selection rule picks the top of the sweep because criterion (d) cannot bind at the upper end
evidence: The preregistered rule freezes lambda as the LARGEST swept fraction satisfying (a) gradient, (b) competence attainable, (c) inactivity not optimal, (d) dynamic range >= 0.5 of the lambda=0 spread. Measured curve: every fraction from 0.125 to 2.0 qualifies; (d) grows with lambda (1.01 -> 1.82) rather than shrinking, so it never limits the upper end, and (b)/(c) hold up to 2.0 x lambda_max because the train-seed headroom (median competent fit 2052 vs abstain 1272, H = 780) is far larger than the ledger's held64 headroom (16 per seed). Frozen lambda = 390 = 2 x lambda_max: a max-burden organism pays 1560, about its whole fitness; a minimum-burden one pays ~120.
proposed_fix: NOT changed: the rule was preregistered and is followed as written; the full curve is published in QUALIFY.json. Consequence to watch at analysis: if the TAX arms lose competence (non-competent excess > 2 per level) the preregistered disposition is INCONCLUSIVE, which is the honest outcome of a tax this strong. A future preregistration should bound the sweep by a criterion that CAN bind above (e.g. the median competent organism must retain at least half its headroom under the tax at its own burden).
found_by: reading the Q3 curve after the run

title: e08 pilot competence on held64 is a 2/4 lineage affair; Q4 passed via local accessibility
evidence: Four 400-generation no-tax pilots all reach train fitness ~2000 (abstain 1272) but only 2/4 have a representative above the held64 competence floor 166.47 (elite held64 107.8-186.1, 16/32 competent). Train seeds are overfit relative to held64. Q4 passed by branch A (single-bond truncation retains competence on 80% of eligible truncations), not branch B (needs 3/4).
proposed_fix: No change. Recorded so the analysis reader expects a substantial non-competent count in EVERY arm and reads the competence-excess rule (TAX minus no-TAX <= 2 per level) rather than absolute counts.

defect_class: A - science blocker (the question could not be verified)
title: e08 minimum-count rule frozen against a pilot that predicted marginal attainability; contrast NOT_VERIFIED
evidence: PREREGISTRATION section 5 requires at least 6 competent lineages per TAX level (of 16) and 4-each-way common support. The disjoint pilot had ALREADY shown (D065) that only 2/4 no-tax lineages reach a held64-competent representative, i.e. an expected ~8 of 16 per level with wide variance - marginal against 6 - and I froze the rule anyway. EXECUTE: competent lineages CONTROL 2/8, TAX 1/8, AMP 2/8, TAX+AMP 3/8 -> 4 per TAX level; common support fails. Disposition INCONCLUSIVE by the frozen rules. The descriptive table is unambiguous and is NOT promoted: scalar burden (all representatives) CONTROL 1.725, TAX 0.834, AMP 0.926, TAX+AMP 0.512, at mean held64 155.7 / 155.4 / 156.0 / 171.2; params 2943 / 1199 / 768 / 377; bits 27.6 / 10.6 / 33.5 / 15.4. The non-competent excess rule (TAX minus no-TAX <= 2 per level) PASSED (+1, -1): the tax did not remove competence relative to control.
proposed_fix: NOT relaxed post hoc. This is the fourth instance of the eligibility-count lesson in the campaign and the first where the count WAS available and was misread as sufficient. A future attempt must (a) make competence attainable on held64 in most lineages before freezing (more generations, or representatives selected by held-out score on a disjoint selection seed set, or a competence floor defined on the assay distribution), and (b) set the minimum count from the pilot's competent-lineage RATE with a margin, or choose the lineage count to guarantee it. Everything else in the design held: accounting, sham, fixtures, contract, blinded assay.

title: e08 fossil of representative genomes was written as .npz, which the repo .gitignore silently excludes
evidence: .gitignore line 492 'roles/**/*.npz' matched fossils/representatives.npz; git status showed the directory as ignored, so the preserved lineages would never have been committed and a recovering executor would have found no fossil.

defect_class: A - science blocker (the question cannot be posed)
title: e09 substrate has no organism-side composition: the organism's only act is one 3-bit nudge per tick
evidence: np_world.py:92-102 / wforge world.py:212-229: x = action % 8; pend[target] += x * 251; the world's own affine maps then transform every register (np_world.py:112-114). The TT organism (genomes.py:213-263) selects a codebook row that is a constant. No operation selection, no invocation, no argument, no organism-owned workspace, no reuse. The only native chain form, c3_ecology.py's straight-line 'program' (ops add/sub/mul/xor/and/or on hex digits), was never a world policy and has no reuse (one consumer per intermediate).
proposed_fix: Closed INCONCLUSIVE / DESIGN UNREACHABLE at reconcile per the brief. A future attempt needs a new organism family with selectable, chainable operations over an owned workspace, and a world screen on which capability generalises to held-out seeds. Substrate build work, not an interface.

title: e09 probe: digit-program policies in w13 overfit the 8 train seeds and sit at or below the abstain floor on held64
evidence: PROBE_E09.json. Single-op exhaustive (2400): train max 1386 vs abstain 1272; held64 of the best-by-train 142.5, max over the top 64 = 159.0 (the abstain floor), 0/64 competent. 3-op arithmetic chains (4 lineages x 150 gens): train 1661-1828, held64 145.6-148.7. Scrambled random op tables: train 1729-1868, held64 148.6-166.2. Depth raises train fitness and nothing survives held64; scrambled equals arithmetic. Same pattern as e08 D065 (TT lineages competent on held64 only 2/4 pilots): train8 selection on w13 rewards seed-specific register trajectories.
proposed_fix: Not acted on here. For the substrate: any future world screen should select on more train seeds or score generalisation directly, because w13's train8 fitness is only loosely coupled to held64 capability across three organism families now (TT, single-op, chain).

defect_class: A - interpretation hazard on a frozen rule
title: P-B03 retention ratio is ill-conditioned in e01's world: useful computation above floor is ~5% of score
evidence: P-B03 (e07 damage in e01's world) reads NEGATIVE under its frozen ability-adjusted contrast (c -0.26, band [-0.12, +0.12]) while RAW retention is twice as high under weather (r STATIC 0.181, WEATHER 0.359) and intact score is 7% lower (0.0547 vs 0.0508). r = (S_dmg - F)/(S_int - F) divides by a margin of ~0.003 (e01's retention advantage), so a 7% change in S_int moves r by tens of percent; the covariate adjustment then extrapolates a steep within-arm r~S_int slope across a 0.004 gap and flips the sign. Damage fires (STATIC r 0.18) and the sham is bit-inert (max deviation 0.0), so the question IS posable here, which was the transplant's point.
proposed_fix: The frozen disposition stands as recorded (NEGATIVE under the preregistered statistic). For the record and the next cycle: report absolute retained score (S_dmg - F) alongside the ratio, and preregister a usefulness margin scaled to the world's own effect size; a re-pose with the absolute measure and a severity dose is the natural next perturbation of T-E07 in this world.
